The '''Entrana Dungeon''' is found on the north-west corner of [[Entrana]]. Entering the dungeon drains your [[Prayer]] to almost zero, and there is no way to climb back up to Entrana from inside.

It is visited during the [[Lost City]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]] [[quests]]. 

There are [[Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)|zombies]], [[greater demon]]s and during the Lost City quest, a [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Dramen Tree Spirit]]. However, [[armour]] and [[weapons]] can't be brought to the island, so the player must obtain their own via killing the zombies or demons.

{{Map|width=250|height=250|align=left|mtype=pin|2820,3374|caption=The entrance to the dungeon.|group=a}}
==Features==
===Dramen Tree===
The main use for this dungeon is the [[Dramen tree]]. During [[Lost City]] and when freeing [[Sir Amik Varze]] in [[Recipe for Disaster]], the player has to cut some [[Dramen branch|branches]] from this tree.

As the player cuts it, a level 101 [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Dramen Tree Spirit]] will appear and attack them. You do not have to defeat the spirit again after slaying it once.

===Monsters===
*[[Zombie (Entrana Dungeon)|Zombies]] (level 25)
*[[Greater demon]]s (level 92)
*The [[Tree spirit (Lost City)|Dramen Tree Spirit]] (level 101)

===Wilderness Exit===
{{main|Magic door}}
Other than teleportation, the only exit is via the magic door leading to level 32 [[Wilderness]]. Players using this exit should be aware that no forms of teleportation work above level 30 Wilderness, and [[Wilderness#Teleport_restrictions|few forms of teleportation]] work above level 20. Due to the risk of encountering [[player killers]], it is inadvisable to use this exit while carrying items that you are unwilling to lose.

{{Map|x=3250|y=3772|plane=0|mtype=pin|caption=The location the player gets teleported to.|align=left}}
{{clear}}

==Trivia==
*[[Taverley Dungeon]] can be seen whilst in the dungeon, since it is part of the dungeon itself, but inaccessible from it. 
*As the dungeon is not considered part of Entrana, it is still possible to receive combat equipment from [[Treasure Trails|Treasure Trail]] [[Reward casket|reward caskets]] within the dungeon.
